title: Advertising Art--A Washing Machine as a Masterpiece
content: This magazine ad from 1957 features a painting by Tom Lovell of an artist at work.It was a different age in advertising, not only because they hired an illustrator for the visual, but because of the rational argument of the copywriting, explaining why they chose the kind of grease they use to lube the machine.------Thanks,Jim Pinkoski (The ultimate collector of Tom Lovell tearsheets.)
